integrity: The proof is analytic and replays the resolvent, Fredholm, Calkin, and Yosida steps from the focal theorem while retaining the asymptotically sharp growth-prefactor estimate; no finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is one-sided: it does not establish equality, sharpness of the exponent, or realization of prescribed compact-approximation coefficients. The coefficient and the semigroup operator norms depend on the chosen equivalent norm.
title: A quantitative BCAP obstruction for nonuniform semigroups under Calkin nilpotence
